chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub, from Sulayman ibn Khalid: the like of it.
And he said: “Her father pays to her husband two-thirds of the blood-money of the miscarried fetus.”

key_terms.أَبُوهَا: her father, the one assigned liability here
key_terms.زَوْجِهَا: her husband, the recipient mentioned in this ruling
key_terms.يُؤَدِّي: pays or delivers as a legal financial obligation

ai.seo_question: Who must pay the diyah for a miscarried fetus according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning liability for the blood-money of a miscarried fetus. It specifies that the woman's father is to pay her husband two-thirds of the diyah of the miscarried fetus, indicating a juristic allocation of financial responsibility and entitlement.
